ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized dense black mottle cluster radiating from the median notch toward the peduncle. Continuous low-intensity border along the trailing edge. Sparse, thin linear dark-gray strokes distributed across the high-intensity white lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 45 degrees; deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations. Distinct jagged peaks and valleys (5-15 pixel depth) distributed along the entire trailing boundary from the distal tips to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex lobes with a secondary concave curve near the distal tips, creating a slight upward flick at the outer edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, circular dark pixel clusters (3-7 pixels in diameter) localized on the lower-mid sections of both white lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks). Three distinct parallel diagonal lines on the left lobe and two intersecting lines on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks (likely odontocete-induced) across the ventral surface; irregular, blunted morphology on the distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible dorsal surfacing of a second whale body in the immediate background to the right of the primary fluke.
